- **Proposed seam for the ruling:** none curative. The conjunct the
  ACs test is one card-runner slice — EX-03 and EX-04 share
  `open_scripted`/`cap_drive`/`packet_check`/`exhausted` and the card
  schema; the 992 lines are honest composition (~60% the two per-case
  drivers + literal-id refusal legs the checker's contract requires;
  ~20% packet/decode machinery; ~20% the test battery). Options, as at
  R5.29/R5.43/R5.44:
  - **AMEND (preferred, `ff31b141`/`9df8f122` precedent)** — rule the
    conjunctive four-family integration one land: splitting EX-03 from
    EX-04 mid-file severs shared helpers (either duplicated — larger —
    or a second module while the checkers read the single owner file);
    a ticket-level split makes the second ticket re-open the same file
    against a landed half — the very "sibling owner" boundary the
    partition forbids.
  - **Code split** — `examples/{ex03,ex04}.rs` submodules: mechanical,
    does not reduce the 992 total; the checker extracts the contract
    from `examples.rs` path only (would need its own edit).
  - **Ticket split** — EX-03 land (~450) then EX-04 land (~450): each
    under the trigger individually, but AC-1's "integrate all four
    example families" is the tested conjunct; the second land edits the
    same runner/case-set lines the first just landed — serial churn on
    identical hunks, no reduction, extra review cycle.
  No acceptance criterion is dropped under any seam.
